Name: AbsoluteCinema
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description:
Adds 10 handy filmmaking and cinematic tools!
Includes a built-in tutorial!
Thanks to Système Éther for suggesting some of the mechanics!

Status.patchnotes: May contain some bugs that I missed!

Name: AfflictionsAndBuffs
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description: Adds 4 new afflictions and 4 buffs!

Name: AfraidoftheDark
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Makes the player anxious at night.

Name: AnimalSounds
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description: Mod allows you to howl like a wolf and more...

Name: AutoFillMaponExplore
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Fills in the map around you as you explore, with a configurable range. Fully compatible with Map Manager.

See readme for more info.

Status.patchnotes: Internal changes to be more futureproof.

Name: AutoTorchLight
Author: hzb1130
Description: Auto Light Torch When it burn out.

Name: DeadAirReborn
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Revival of DeadAir mod made by TonisGaming

Status.patchnotes: Updated for 2.55. Filters drain can be set on IN-GAME TIME I wanted. Integration of ModData for starter kit persistence.

Name: DebugOutput
Author: Danileros
Description:
Debug Output is a mod created specifically for mod developers.

It assists in mod debugging by enabling a special debug mode that displays important mod parameters in real time as text or a table.

See readme for more info.

Name: DuplicateItemFix
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Fixes sticks, stones, coal and other items that you can pick up again and again from the same spot. It cleans up the bad data in your save as each region loads. Works automatically, with no settings.

Status.patchnotes: First release. Back up your saves first.
Status.notes: Repairs existing damage only. Regions you never revisit keep their damage.

Name: ExpandedSkills
Author: EtherSystem
Description: A mod to expand vanilla skills to a maximum of 10 levels

Status.patchnotes: reworked skill reward handling, fixing Cooking (yes, again...), Gunsmithing and Fire Starting progression issues, plus general cleanup
Status.issues: Some funkiness can be expected for milling machines and several inconsistent stuff every here and there, will be fixed one day.

Name: ExpandedTradingFramework
Author: EtherSystem
Description: A framework for creating custom trades for the trader.

Status.patchnotes: Fix some icon/SR issues

Name: FastTravel
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Lets you save any number of places, and fast travel to them anytime at the press of a button. Includes balance options. For example, you can have one home base while you explore the world, without the tedium of transferring your hoard to each region.

See readme and save safety for more info.

Status.patchnotes: Added new GUI to manage fast travel destinations. Added support for naming and reordering destinations. Added support for any number of destinations beyond 9. Fixed wrong region name shown on-screen when traveling across regions. The mod is no longer experimental.

Name: FatDestroyer
Author: Data-0
Description: Despawn any low condition fat around the world, so it doesn't just stay ruined outside your door forever.

Status.patchnotes: Updated for 2.51

Name: FreeLook
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Finally look around freely while walking! Keep an eye on predators or just take in the beautiful scenery.

Status.patchnotes: Recall: tap X to swing back to whatever you were last looking at. Plus fixes for object placement and wolf struggles.

Name: HuntBroadcast
Author: hzb1130
Description: Damage and kill info broadcast

Name: ImprovedFirstAidPanel
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Small QoL to improved the First Aid Panel, making the panel easier to use by adding body-area filtering and direct treatment buttons

Status.patchnotes: fix issues with intestinal parasites

Name: InterloperHUDPro
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Adds a few new HUD displays.

Status.patchnotes: Added a new option to display WeatherOverhaul weather stage

Name: ItemScanner
Author: hzb1130
Description: TLD MOD that scans nearby items, containers, and harvestable plants around the player and displays their locations on screen.

Name: JustZoom
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description:
Just press Z to zoom in, then use the mouse wheel to zoom in or out! Everything is also adjustable in ModSettings.
Please don't use it with AbsoluteCinema mod

Name: LongLargo
Author: Danileros
Description:
Long Largo is a mod with a single goal: to enhance your gaming experience by improving the music.

Long Largo restores music from the story campaign and integrates it into your playthrough.

...And you can even disable wolf stalking sound!

Status.patchnotes: New features: disable copyright music, wintermute wolf stalking. Settings reworked. Missing dependencies message is gone.

Name: MajorMiseries
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Adds 20 new major afflictions and 1 new buff.

Status.patchnotes: Way too much stuff, read the mod's readme

Name: MapIconFix
Author: hzb1130
Description: Fixed the issue where the plant collection icon on the map would not disappear after gathering.

Name: MinorMiseries
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Adds 14 new minor afflictions and 3 new buffs.

Status.patchnotes: Fixed a bug preventing cooking recipes from being fully completed due to afflictions crafting penalities, leaving progress stuck at a lower percentage

Name: MoreFuelAccelerant
Author: hzb1130
Description: Tinder, charcoal and fat as fuel. The accelerant is consumed more slowly.

Name: MotionTracker
Author: okclm
Description: Adds a minimap that can show animals, spraypaint markings, and select gear.

Status.patchnotes: TLD 2.55 / Added ability to control the radar mini map placement on the screen.

Name: Murmurations
Author: EtherSystem
Description: An experimental mod aiming to add murmurations to the game

Status.patchnotes: Fix the animated birds not working after a reload

Name: NoHarvestAnimations
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Disables the first-person carcass harvesting and quartering animations, using the game's native progress circle instead. Optionally speeds harvesting and quartering up in real time, leaving the in-game time they cost unchanged.

Name: NoCameraSway
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description: Camera will stop swaying

Status.patchnotes: Sway now has a speed and amplitude of 0.001 to prevent triggering a bob
Status.notes: Camera will sway in the background if you open the menu

Name: NoMoreCabinFever
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description: Disables cabin fever

Name: ObjectSinkFix
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Fixes furniture sinking into floors and the ground, and containers vanishing when you return to a location. Puts sunken furniture back and brings lost containers back, on existing saves. Works automatically.

Status.patchnotes: First release. Stops furniture sinking, restores furniture that already sank, stops containers vanishing on reload, and brings back containers the bug already removed. One optional setting with ModSettings.
Status.notes: ModSettings is optional and only needed for the one setting.

Name: OxygenLevels
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Add a system to simulate oxygen deprivation based on the player's altitude.

Name: PZLoadingScreen
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Just a custom PZ-like custom loading screens mod

Name: PlacingGeometrically
Author: hzb1130
Description:
A variant of Placing Anywhere that adds some functionality.
几何学放置（中文版在GitHub）。

Name: PrepperCache
Author: okclm
Description: Provides access to prepper cache information for the current game.

Status.patchnotes: TLD 2.5 / Unity 6 fix.

Name: QoLFirestart
Author: Danileros
Description:
QoL FireStart is a mod that makes fire starting process a little simpler by choosing optimal gear.

This includes choosing a torch if lit, or a magnifying lens if weather permits, as well as protecting the birchbark and choosing a book or stick as fuel.

Name: QoLStaminaStays
Author: Danileros
Description: QoL StaminaStays is a simple mod that prevents stamina bar fadeout by timer. Stamina now fades only when it is full like in most modern games.

Status.patchnotes: Fixed other reasons to disappear

Name: ResumePreviewer
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Displays the SaveSlot that will be loaded before pressing Resume in the Main Menu.

Name: SaveBackup
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Automatically creates hourly and daily backups of your save files. Particularly when playing with mods, this lets you recover your save if something goes wrong.

See readme for more info.

Status.patchnotes: Added option to trigger a backup at any time.

Name: SeamlessInteriors
Author: Hamsi Buglama
Description: A massive overhaul mod developed for The Long Dark that aims to integrate all interior buildings directly into the open world without any loading screens. Walk through doors seamlessly and experience the interior and exterior as one unified environment.

Status.patchnotes: Initial Release
Status.notes:
This mod is very early in development. Even after testing, it may contain bugs that haven't been discovered yet. You can use it with your primary/master save files, but be sure to back up your files. Please consider the risks before installing.

There is a high risk of conflicts with other mods that modify the structure or interior of buildings. It has not yet been tested with other custom interior mods.

Name: ShowTraderTrust
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Shows your current trust level with the trader when talking with him on the radio.

See readme for more info.

Status.patchnotes: Fixed performance impact for some players; internal changes to be more futureproof.

Name: SilentWalker
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Pack your gear like a seasoned survivor: bottles full and upright, metal separated and wrapped, firewood tied down. Makes your movement quieter for you, the wildlife, or both, with separate sliders for small supplies, wood, metal and water.

Status.patchnotes: COMPLETE OVERHAUL! Now with two modes - Linked: One slider makes your footsteps quieter, for you AND for wildlife - Separate: Tune how much is just what you hear versus what the wildlife hears. Plus pack noise sliders for small supplies, wood, metal and water, detailed ground, clothing and tone controls, and an Enabled switch. Your 1.0.0 settings carry over.

Name: StrongFishingLine
Author: Data-0
Description: A small item that spawns around containers in the world. Usually found in fishing huts. It gives some fishing lines when broken down.

Status.patchnotes: Updated for 2.51

Name: SutherlandExpandedStock
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Content mod using ETF for creating 56 new custom trades for the trader.

Name: TheLongMood
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Adds Project Zomboid–style Boredom & Depression to The Long Dark.

Status.patchnotes: Fixed a bug preventing cooking recipes from being fully completed due to afflictions crafting penalities, leaving progress stuck at a lower percentage

Name: TranslatedTextures
Author: LittleWolfStorm
Description: Translates every single texture to Russian! (Special thanks to mik5937 for testing and helping with localization)

Name: WeatherDisplay
Author: hzb1130
Description: Displays current weather information on screen.

Name: WeatherOverhaul
Author: EtherSystem
Description: A mod designed to make vanilla weather predictable and add new custom weather stages

Status.patchnotes: the visual effects of the various aurora variants are now correctly visible in indoor environments (with the exception of snowfall, to prevent it from appearing indoors, for obvious reasons of realism)

Name: WeightlessWoodworkingTools
Author: Data-0
Description: Makes the woodworking tools weight almost nothing. The player shouldn't be punished for wanting to decorate their home

Status.patchnotes: Updated for 2.51

Name: WindMovementFix
Author: EtherSystem
Description: Just a little fix for the wind speed debuff bug

Name: WolfHowlFix
Author: Lycanthor
Description: Fixes the broken "give up the chase" timer that makes wolf howls stutter and restart endlessly, most noticeable on aurora nights. Bears and cougars share the same defect and are fixed too. No animal tuning is changed.
